linter.description: Declared linter. Mesh resolves to a vetted command + config-discovery rule; arbitrary tools are rejected.

path.description: Sandbox path to lint. Defaults to the workspace root.

config_ref.description: Optional sandbox reference to an explicit config file (e.g. .eslintrc.json, pyproject.toml). Omit to use the linter's own discovery.

fix.description: When true and the linter supports it, autofixable issues are written back to the sandbox. Risk class is upgraded; lease requires write scope and human approval.

severity_floor.description: Suppress findings below this severity in the response. 'error' returns only errors; 'info' returns everything.

findings.description: Per-finding records. Truncated to 1000 entries; counts always reflect the full run.

files_changed.description: Populated only when fix=true. Zero when fix is off.

summary: Run a vetted linter or type-checker against the workspace and return structured findings. Read-only unless fix=true.
notes: fix=true upgrades the lease to include 'fs.write:sandbox://workspace/' and trips human approval. Diff-only review is preferred — chain to diff-review after a fix run.
